verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs describe an official iOS app installable from the App Store as "Claude by Anthropic", and claude.com advertises chat on iOS and Android. Voice mode is documented on Claude Mobile for both iOS and Android and is described as working best from your phone. missing for 10: evidence of feature parity with web/desktop on mobile (e.g., projects, artifacts, file upload, connectors), an Android-specific install doc, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality.
